caption: The drawing depicts a single standing female figure carved in a classical style, representing a statue of a muse. The figure is shown with detailed drapery covering most of her body, colored in shades of beige and light brown, suggesting aged or weathered stone or wood. Her hair is styled with wavy lines and covered with a portion of her garment. The figure's left arm is bent, with her hand resting against her cheek, while her right arm is bent across her torso, holding a scroll. The feet are visible at the bottom, positioned on an ornately decorated base composed of two scroll-like elements. The background is a plain, light off-white color, and below the figure, there is a label in capital letters reading "MUSE WITH A SCROLL." The drawing uses fine lines and shaded areas to create the appearance of texture and three-dimensionality.
title: Muse with a Scroll
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
